title: TRIM28 aggravates myocardial infarction-induced cardiomyocyte apoptosis through regulating the stability of ATF5 via ubiquitination and SUMOylation.
authors: Wang, Yanying; Yang, Mingyu; Ren, Junting; Liu, Wei; Sun, Han; Wang, Guangze; Wang, Siyu; Zhang, Ying; Li, Haodong; Liu, Dongping; Li, Mengmeng; Zhang, Yanwei; Wang, Hao; Yang, Xuewen; Zhang, Xiyang; Liu, Yuhan; Jiao, Lei; Sun, Lihua; Xuan, Lina; Li, Xuelian; Fan, Shasha; Gong, Manyu; Zhang, Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TRIM28通过泛素化/SUMO化调控ATF5稳定性影响心肌梗死凋亡，虽涉及蛋白互作但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA，仅分子对接为辅助手段，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模无关。
abstract: Myocardial infarction (MI) stands as a leading contributor to global cardiovascular morbidity and mortality, defined by ischemic myocardial cell death and subsequent impairment of cardiac function. The tripartite motif (TRIM) protein family has been shown to regulate myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury. As a key member of the TRIM protein family, tripartite motif-containing protein 28 (TRIM28) exhibits dysregulated expression in the heart during MI yet its pathophysiological role remains to be fully elucidated. This study aimed to investigate the functional roles and underlying mechanisms of TRIM28 in MI. We observed a significant upregulation of TRIM28 in ischemic myocardium and hypoxic cardiomyocytes. Genetic knockout of TRIM28 ameliorated cardiac function and attenuated apoptosis in MI mice, whereas its overexpression exacerbated contractile dysfunction, and promoted cardiomyocyte apoptosis and mitochondrial injury. Mechanistically, TRIM28 directly interacts with activating transcription factor 5 (ATF5) and suppresses its SUMOylation, thereby enhancing the ubiquitin-mediated degradation of ATF5, inhibiting the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt), and ultimately culminating in increased apoptosis. Via molecular docking, we identified a TRIM28-targeting compound, Oolonghomobisflavan B (OFB), which attenuated post-MI apoptosis and facilitated cardiac function recovery. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that TRIM28 acts as a critical regulator of MI progression, and OFB holds therapeutic potential as a candidate drug.
abstract_zh: 心肌梗死（MI）是全球心血管发病率和死亡率的主要贡献因素，其特征为缺血性心肌细胞死亡及随后心功能受损。三结构域（TRIM）蛋白家族已被证明可调节心肌缺血再灌注损伤。作为TRIM蛋白家族的关键成员，含三结构域蛋白28（TRIM28）在MI期间心脏中表现出表达失调，但其病理生理作用仍有待充分阐明。本研究旨在探讨TRIM28在MI中的功能作用及其潜在机制。我们观察到TRIM28在缺血心肌和低氧心肌细胞中显著上调。TRIM28的基因敲除改善了MI小鼠的心脏功能并减轻了凋亡，而其过表达则加剧了收缩功能障碍，并促进心肌细胞凋亡和线粒体损伤。机制上，TRIM28直接与激活转录因子5（ATF5）相互作用并抑制其SUMO化修饰，从而增强ATF5的泛素介导降解，抑制线粒体未折叠蛋白反应（UPRmt），最终导致凋亡增加。通过分子对接，我们鉴定了一种靶向TRIM28的化合物——乌龙茶双黄烷B（OFB），该化合物可减轻MI后凋亡并促进心脏功能恢复。综上，这些发现表明TRIM28是MI进展的关键调控因子，且OFB具有作为候选药物的治疗潜力。
